product_summary: Biopharmaceutical manufacturer (Bengaluru, Karnataka — NOT Delhi as claimed). Real product lines per company profile: (1) generic small-molecule APIs sold to ~120 countries; (2) novel biologics and biosimilars — rh-insulin (INSUGEN), insulin glargine (BASALOG), trastuzumab (CANMAb), bevacizumab (KRABEVA), nimotuzumab (BIOMAb EGFR), itolizumab (ALZUMAb); (3) branded formulations for India in metabolics, oncology, immunotherapy, nephrology — glimepiride+metformin (BLISTO), everolimus (Evertor), tacrolimus (TACROGRAF); (4) historically enzymes (papain, isinglass) for brewing; (5) research services via subsidiary Syngene. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biocon (company profile citing Biocon annual report and product pages). Biocon's own website (www.biocon.com) could not be opened from this environment — SSL certificate verification failure and timeouts on /products/ and /products/active-pharmaceutical-ingredients/; DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'connection refused' for all queries. Therefore the product list is corroborated only by the secondary company profile, not by a live read of the company catalogue.
comment: HS comparison: declared 2916.39 (aromatic monocarboxylic acids/derivatives), 2922.19 (amino-alcohols/phenols/ethers), 2933.19 and 2933.39 (N-heterocycles) — these are plausible API-level codes for a small-molecule API maker and 2933.39 is a genuine hit for Biocon's heterocyclic API chemistry, so status is PARTIAL, not wrong. However the declaration is materially incomplete for the actual business: it contains no Chapter 30 line at all, while the bulk of Biocon's revenue-relevant portfolio is finished/bulk biologics and formulations — insulins (3004.39), monoclonal antibodies (3002.15), and oral cytostatics/immunosuppressants (3004.90). It also misses enzymes (3507.90), which is the company's founding product line. Industry misclassification: declared 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) — Biocon is a biopharmaceutical/biotech company, not oil & gas; the correct sector is pharma/biotech. Geography misclassification: declared state 'Delhi'; registered headquarters is Bengaluru, Karnataka (Electronic City). Name spelling: input 'BICON LIMITED' vs legal 'BIOCON LIMITED' — likely a transcription error, but I did not verify the registry, so this is flagged, not asserted. Trader signs: none — the profile describes own manufacturing sites and own brands, consistent with manufacturer role; no evidence of pure trading. Per project rule 3, no HS mismatch justifies rejection: company is retained and codes corrected to the actual product mix. All Chapter 30 and enzyme codes above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' in the sense that no customs line was available to me in this task (customs/registry/volume research explicitly out of scope); they are derived from the documented product portfolio, not from shipment records. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN: not researched per scope — null.
